download_file_from_url: download a file from a URL to a specified directory with progress tracking
unzip_file_to_directory: unzip a zip file into a target directory with optional overwrite control
zip_directory_contents: create a zip archive from a directory with deflated compression and relative paths
download_and_unzip_file: download a zip file from a URL and extract it to a target directory
make_clean_directory: create a directory or clear all contents if the directory already exists
